heroHeadline: Trump Calls Off Planned Iran Strike at Gulf Leaders' Request — Military 'Ready on a Moment's Notice' for 'Full, Large Scale Assault'; US-Iran 'Closing In on Framework'; Iran: 'Any Assault Resolutely Thwarted' — Day 81
heroSubtitle: Day 81 (May 19): President Trump announced via Truth Social that he called off a planned military attack on Iran after leaders of Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the UAE personally contacted him requesting he 'hold off' because 'serious negotiations are now taking place.' Trump simultaneously warned the US military remains ready to 'go forward with a full, large scale assault of Iran, on a moment's notice.' The NSC Situation Room meeting reviewed strike options with VP Vance, Rubio, Hegseth, JCS Chairman Gen. Caine, and CIA Director Ratcliffe present. Iran declared any US 'massive assault' would be 'resolutely thwarted.' The Times of Israel reported the US and Iran are 'closing in on a framework' for a permanent nuclear deal even as bomb threats continue. The IEA announced the Iran war has created the 'largest supply disruption in the history of the global oil market' — a 3.9 million bpd deficit with steepest inventory draws projected for May–June.
